name: Defibox
rootCause: Defibox discovered an abnormal exchange situation of the EOS-EMOON trading pair at 22:00 on September 16th. After an emergency investigation, the swap contract was suspended at 0:00 on September 17th, and it was reopened on the morning of September 17th after auditing and multiple signings were completed. Swap contract. This exchange abnormality is caused by the incompatibility between the Defibox Swap contract and the EMOON contract. Before the event, the number of pots was 482636464535179.88 EMOON/4866.1494 EOS.
